assertion_results.text: Performance goal is made measurable with a specific metric and numeric target
assertion_results.evidence: Performance requirements: "Reduce initial page load time by at least 30% compared with the baseline."

assertion_results.text: 'Look nicer' is replaced with concrete, enumerable UI changes
assertion_results.evidence: UI/UX requirements list concrete changes including "Standardize spacing, typography, colors, borders, and button styles," "Make primary metrics visually prominent," and "Cards should have consistent padding and sizing."

assertion_results.text: Includes how completion would be verified or tested
assertion_results.evidence: Validation section specifies comparing "before/after performance metrics" and testing layouts at "1440px desktop width," "768px tablet width," and "375px mobile width."
